summary: Backend-only verification of the new admin-only Screen-Capture + Store-Listing system at /api/admin/screen-captures. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter90_screen_captures_admin.py (13 tests, all PASS). Verified: (1) AUTH matrix — 401 with no Bearer, 401 with wrong Bearer, 403 with a RIDER session token (demo@roujaune.app), 200 with the HWG service token. (2) /screens returns exactly 10 screens with the expected keys {home, plan, workouts, workout_list, scenic, progress, fitness, calendar, profile, wellness}. (3) /status returns valid shape (status ∈ idle|running|done|error; has total, done, screens). (4) List (GET '') returns items containing thumb_base64 but NEITHER raw_base64 NOR framed_base64. (5) /store-listing GET returns all 5 fields (title, subtitle, promotional_text, description, keywords). (6) PUT /store-listing with {subtitle:'Test subtitle'} updated ONLY subtitle; title and description unchanged and persistence confirmed via follow-up GET. Original subtitle was restored ('Train Smarter. Ride Legends.') after the test. (7) GET /{key}?variant=framed returns image/png 200 with a valid PNG magic header; variant=bogus returns 422; unknown key returns 404. (8) /export returns application/zip 200 with Content-Disposition: attachment and a valid ZIP magic header. No 409 concurrency check was triggered (per instructions we did NOT POST /refresh to avoid the ~90s capture). Success rate backend: 100% (13/13).
critical_code_review_comments: screen_capture.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id from every response (find({}, {'_id': 0, ...})).

capture_router is gated globally via `dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_admin)]`, so require_user() runs first (→ 401 when unauthenticated) then role check (→ 403 for riders). Matches the AUTH matrix requirement precisely.
List endpoint correctly projects out raw_base64 and framed_base64 to keep the payload light — verified in test.

The `/{key}` route accepts any string, so /nonexistentkey routes here and returns 404 via the DB lookup (works as tested). Because the route is declared AFTER /screens, /status, /export, /store-listing they take precedence — path ordering is correct.

Partial PUT via `{k: v for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` correctly preserves untouched fields. `updates` includes an 'updated_at' field written to Mongo but not returned by GET (harmless — GET strips _id and returns whatever is in the doc, which does include updated_at; not asserted against).
seed_data_creation: None. Used the DB seeded by the main agent's earlier full refresh (10 captures + generated store listing). The PUT-subtitle test restores the original subtitle after mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The router prefix is /api/admin/screen-captures. Auth is enforced by the shared auth.require_admin dependency, so all endpoints return 401 without a Bearer, 403 with a rider Bearer, and 200 with the HWG service token (Bearer <redacted-old-rotated-token>). Do NOT POST /refresh unless a 409 concurrency check is explicitly needed — it takes ~90s and hits the live preview URL. Do NOT drop the screen_captures collection. The rider account for the 403 test is demo@roujaune.app / demo9900 via POST /api/auth/login. Reusable pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter90_screen_captures_admin.py.
